newsitem.title: TANZANIA: More than 80,000 AIDS cases reported in Tanzania.
newsitem.headline: More than 80,000 AIDS cases reported in Tanzania.

text.p: Tanzanian ministry of health figures released on Sunday show 81,498 confirmed cases of AIDS in the East African nation.
But medical sources said the report, compiled by the ministry's National Aids Control Programme (NACP), only covered the situation to the end of 1995, and current figures were "much higher".
Although the disease was unknown before the 1980s, all regions in Tanzania had reported AIDS cases by 1986. By 1990, a cumulative total of 25,503 cases had been reported to NACP.
An estimated 1.29 million Tanzanians, out of a population totalling about 30 million, are already infected with the HIV virus which leads to AIDS, health officials say.
